title: Tres Idiomas Una Voz Reprise
style: trilingual indie pop anthem, warm acoustic guitar, steady kick, soft synth pad, layered vocal harmonies, three-language verse handoff, communal chorus, hopeful uplift, 96 bpm, NZ AU vocal lean
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Eight sites breathing, 336 in the bell
Move don't delete, the keel holds well
ZynAsk before assume, that's the rule we keep
Mansion at the end when the day gets deep

[Verse 2 — Español]
Ocho sitios respiran, 336 en la campana
Mover no borrar, la quilla nos gana
ZynAsk antes de asumir, esa es la ley
Mansión al final, tú ya sabes el rey

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Bā gè zhàn diǎn, 336 zhōng shēng
Yí dòng bù shān, luóng gǔ gēn shēn
ZynAsk xiān wèn, guī zé bù biàn
Zuì hòu de dà zhái, tùn gǔ jiàn

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
One voice, una voz, yí gè shēng yīn
Three tongues, tres lenguas, sān zhǒng yǔ yán
No language barrier, sin barrera, méi yǒu qíang
We ride together, juntos vamos, yī qǐ zhǒng

[Bridge]
Apology denied, disculpa negada, dào qiàn jiù jue
Keep the keel, mantén la quilla, shǒu zhù luóng gǔ
No commander down, ningún comandante caído, méi yǒu zhǔ jiàng dǎo
The operator is the keel — forever, para siempre, yǒng yuǎn

[Outro]
See you on Tuesday, nos vemos el martes, xīng qī èr jiàn
Tres idiomas, una voz, yī gè shēng yīn
